mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, tunnel_uuid, version, token_hash, ciphertext, nonce, wrapped_dek, format_version, key_provider, key_version, created_at, retired_at, archived_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_tunnel_token_versions ( uuid, external_id, tunnel_uuid, version, token_hash, ciphertext, nonce, wrapped_dek, format_version, key_provider, key_version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.TunnelUUID}, #{params.Version}, #{params.TokenHash,sensitive=true}, #{params.Ciphertext,sensitive=true}, #{params.Nonce,sensitive=true}, #{params.WrappedDEK,sensitive=true}, #{params.FormatVersion}, #{params.KeyProvider}, #{params.KeyVersion}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_tunnel_token_versions WHERE tunnel_uuid = #{tunnelUUID} AND retired_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM mcp_tunnel_token_versions WHERE tunnel_uuid = #{tunnelUUID} AND retired_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT tv.uuid, tv.external_id, tv.tunnel_uuid, tv.version, tv.token_hash, tv.ciphertext, tv.nonce, tv.wrapped_dek, tv.format_version, tv.key_provider, tv.key_version, tv.created_at, tv.retired_at, tv.archived_at, t.external_id AS tunnel_external_id, t.organization_uuid, t.workspace_uuid, t.archived_at AS tunnel_archived_at FROM mcp_tunnel_token_versions tv JOIN mcp_tunnels t ON t.uuid = tv.tunnel_uuid WHERE tv.token_hash = #{tokenHash,sensitive=true} AND t.external_id = #{tunnelExternalID}
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_tunnel_token_versions SET retired_at = #{retiredAt}, ciphertext = NULL, nonce = NULL, wrapped_dek = NULL, format_version = NULL, key_provider = NULL, key_version = NULL WHERE tunnel_uuid = #{tunnelUUID} AND retired_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL

UPDATE mcp_tunnel_token_versions SET archived_at = COALESCE(archived_at, #{archivedAt}), ciphertext = NULL, nonce = NULL, wrapped_dek = NULL, format_version = NULL, key_provider = NULL, key_version = NULL WHERE tunnel_uuid = #{tunnelUUID}
